resolved.StateStore.reportEffective: Synchronous report, called through the scheduler runtime view: decideStamp checks the current runtime token before applying the patch. No callback registered here; token rejection exercised by device lives and reports.

resolved.ConfigStore.load: Delegates to commandLane (core/commands.js, built on the finished createLane fence); this wrapper awaits an admitted file read, registers no callback, and never overlaps another read or write. File/watch sites here cover content acceptance.
resolved.OverlayService.clearSettings: Synchronous command/reducer delegation: no independent callback registered here. applyOutputs/applySupersede feed the finished reducer; writes delegate to writeMirror whose publish/result sites are inventoried in this file.
resolved.OverlayService.publishControl: Synchronous command/reducer delegation: no independent callback registered here. applyOutputs/applySupersede feed the finished reducer; writes delegate to writeMirror whose publish/result sites are inventoried in this file.
resolved.OverlayService.applyOutputs: Synchronous command/reducer delegation: no independent callback registered here. applyOutputs/applySupersede feed the finished reducer; writes delegate to writeMirror whose publish/result sites are inventoried in this file.
resolved.SettingsService.save: The API wrapper reserves the highest seen draft on admission, then delegates to a per-device commandLane. saveNow checks device incarnation and decideStamp on committed draft inside that lane before writing; previews remain independent. No additional callback is registered here.
resolved.SettingsService.preview: Synchronous request/context API with no independent input callback: drafts use decideStamp before mutation; Save delegates to the config commandLane and rechecks device incarnation; instance callbacks are delivered via commandLane from the inventoried source listeners, checking InstanceRef and incarnation.
resolved.SettingsService.endPreview: Synchronous request/context API with no independent input callback: drafts use decideStamp before mutation; Save delegates to the config commandLane and rechecks device incarnation; instance callbacks are delivered via commandLane from the inventoried source listeners, checking InstanceRef and incarnation.

resolved.StateStore.chooseScene: Delegates to the per-device commandLane (core/commands.js/createLane); this wrapper registers no callback. Incarnation checked before running and after saving; PIXD-91 documents the unchanged frozen plan boundary.
